The `root` must be an `r#` reference. Let me reconsider the motion structure. The `let` word takes `[b#, value, then]`. I need to express the full `n0` subtree as a motion, with `normalizedId` bound to `var(rawId)` instead of `call(trim_ascii, rawId)`.

The root of the replacement at `n1` is just a `var` node. The root ref should be `r0`, and the motion `var[r0, s0]` means "r0 is a var referencing s0 (rawId parameter)".
